name: @openshapeforge/example-plugin-workflow-domain-nodes
description: Example plugin: the domain workflow node packs as their own catalog slice (generator + authoring layer + seed step).
//dependencies: yaml parses the node-config authoring files in src/, and is the only value this package imports from anywhere: the compiler half reads YAML and writes JSON, and the runtime half applies that JSON through the API's catalog-seed helper, whose kysely and DB references are type-only and so pull in nothing at run time. It must be declared here rather than borrowed from apps/api or the workflow plugin — a bare specifier does not resolve from examples/. Keep the range in step with examples/plugins/workflow: both parse the same authoring files into two slices of one table, and a version skew would be a parse difference between them.
